welcome.title: Welcome to spark233
welcome.description: Find commands and enter plugin workspaces here. Notes, search, and other tools are provided by their plugins.
welcome.keys: Type a keyword, choose with ↑ ↓, and press Enter. Keep typing inside a mode, or press Esc to return. Enable or disable each plugin in plugin management.

launcher.startingHint: Commands will be available when preparation finishes. You can check plugin status now.
launcher.placeholder: Search applications, commands, or plugin keywords…
launcher.empty: No matching commands. Try another keyword or check whether the plugin is enabled.
launcher.navigation: ↑ ↓ Select · Enter Run · Esc Back or hide
launcher.modeHint: Keyword + Tab to enter a mode
launcher.settingsDescription: Change application preferences and save them to spark233.

migrate.title: Move data directory
migrate.description: Move the existing note data to the selected location. Please wait until the move finishes.

ocr.textLabel: Recognized text — edit or select part of the text

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: Save preferences, note text and attachments, plugin versions and enabled states, and plugin data such as clipboard history together. Restore verifies every file and preserves a copy of the current data.
backup.inspecting: Verifying the backup manifest and files…
backup.restoring: Restoring. Please wait until the operation finishes…
backup.creating: Saving data and creating a consistent snapshot…
backup.confirmDescription: Restore these plugin versions, granted capabilities, and data. Current data will be preserved separately. Open notes are asked to save first; restore is cancelled if saving cannot finish.
backup.selectionChanged: This backup changed after preview. Select it again and verify it before restoring.

translation.title: Dictionary and translation
translation.dictionaryHint: About 770,000 base entries, with inflections and phrases. Looking up a word never sends a network request.
translation.localEmpty: Enter a word to look it up
translation.localEmptyHint: If there is no local definition, you can explicitly use AI translation below.
translation.aiHint: Connects only when you click Translate. Chinese defaults to English; other languages default to Simplified Chinese.
translation.needConfig: Save a compatible service address and model below first. The local dictionary is still available.
translation.notCached: The result was received, but its cache could not be saved.
translation.configHint: One configuration is active at a time. The key is stored in the plugin’s private directory and is never included in query results or shown again.
translation.endpointHint: Use HTTPS. Local localhost / 127.0.0.1 services may use HTTP.
translation.keyHint: Leave blank to keep the saved key. A local service without authentication may leave this empty.

plugins.actionUnavailable: This action is unavailable. Enable or recover the corresponding plugin in plugin management.

catalog.title: Official offline plugin catalog
catalog.description: The seven official plugins included with this installer. Install or reinstall offline, then review the installation and requested capabilities.

plugins.title: Plugin management
plugins.description: Review imported plugins before installation. Updates are checked automatically; you choose when to install them.
plugins.errorHint: Expand the details to see the cause, then retry the affected action.
plugins.commandRunningHint: You can still disable the plugin. The host will ask it to save and cancel its tasks first.

add.title: Add plugin
add.description: Import a local .tgz, a prebuilt development directory, or an npm package. Packages must contain a valid spark233 plugin manifest.

plugins.registryHint: Leave blank for the official npm registry. Other registries must use HTTPS.
plugins.channelHint: Leave blank to use the latest stable channel.
plugins.manifest: View full manifest and integrity information

native.title: This plugin can run Node or native code
native.description: This code has your user account’s full system access, including files and networks. Web capability restrictions do not constrain Node or native code. Install it only if you trust its source.
native.confirm: I trust this source and allow Node / native execution

empty.title: No plugins installed
empty.description: Add a local package or a specific npm source, then confirm installation to use it.

plugins.updateHint: Prepare the update, then review its source and capabilities before confirming installation.
plugins.uninstallDescription: The plugin will stop and be removed. Its data is kept by default so it can be reinstalled later.
plugins.deleteDataHint: Deletes the plugin’s private data permanently. This cannot be undone.
